UNITED STATES DISTRICT COURT
FOR THE EASTERN DISTRICT OF VIRGINIA
ALEXANDRIA DIVISION

MARVELLE J. BALLENTINE, Plaintiff, v. KATIE HALL, individually; NATIONAL CENTER FOR MISSING & EXPLOITED CHILDREN; META PLATFORMS, INC.; and JOHN/JANE DOES 1–6, Defendants. ____________________________________/ | Case No. 1:26-cv-02331

[PROPOSED] ORDER

This matter is before the Court on Plaintiff’s Motion for Leave to Supplement ECF No. 133 With an Offer of Resolution (ECF No. __). Upon consideration of the Motion, the Memorandum in Support, any response and reply, and the record, it is hereby ORDERED:

1.	The Motion is GRANTED.

2.	Exhibit A to the Motion is DEEMED FILED as a supplement to ECF No. 133.

3.	The Court will consider the supplement in ruling on ECF No. 133.

4.	This Order does not stay the action, extend any deadline, or withdraw or modify any pending motion or objection.

The Clerk is directed to provide a copy of this Order to pro se Plaintiff at his last known address.

Alexandria, Virginia

__________, 2026

______________________________

Rossie D. Alston, Jr.

United States District Judge
